notes: No kinds merged or dropped; all four planned kinds kept with their old sources. Attribute-only variants were moved into t: drive type and bed form for care beds, foam/air/alternating construction for mattresses and cushions, and rail type for bed rails. For JAY cushions, the generic 'JAY wheelchair cushions' range was dropped as a duplicate of the kind itself; 'JAY J2 Series' was kept as range 'JAY J2'. The 'Invacare' prefix was removed from model names because maker is a separate field. No research was allowed on this shelf, so no models were added for Drive, Sidhil or ROHO; they remain gaps for a sourced pass. Candidates to verify include the ROHO High Profile air-cell cushion, the Sidhil Bradshaw care bed and Drive Medical bed-assist rails. Bed rail keeps no models; it is a kind a household plausibly owns, and trade-level SKUs were not added.
